description: Manage SurrealDB databases and Cloud resources through the managed OAuth MCP server

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to SurrealDB's managed MCP server with OAuth. Work with SurrealQL, schemas, and records, or manage Cloud instances, organizations, access, and spend. The plugin also includes official SurrealDB skills for query design, vector search, SDK usage, and related workflows.
